Drafted from manifests and workspace configuration by `discovery/draft-typescript-node-stack-scope.mjs`: one `package.json` per Project, included when it matches the stack's manifest facts and excluded naming its differences otherwise. A maintained workspace root package is a Project alongside its members; a shared-only root is not. Uncertain root membership stays unresolved. A root package without workspace members is a Project.

candidates.reason: The Project of `package.json` matches the typescript-node stack's manifest facts: pnpm 11, its lockfile, Node.js 24 or 26, oxlint 1, Prettier 3 and a validate script. This is the only maintained Project: pnpm-workspace.yaml has no members. TypeScript 7 typechecks src via tsconfig.json; tests use node --test; required Test aggregates both Node 24 and 26 pnpm validate jobs; docs/development/README.md names the tools. No other stack is used.
